# POSFood — Flutter Point of Sale (POS) App UI

> A modern, responsive Point of Sale (POS) restaurant order management UI cloned from `https://github.com/ZETIC7Z/flutter-pos-app-ui` and running locally with full interactive POS capabilities.

## Features
- Side navigation menu with animated selections (`Home`, `Menu`, `History`, `Promos`, `Settings`)
- Food category filtering (`Burger`, `Noodles`, `Drinks`, `Desserts`)
- Product grid view with high-resolution item photography, stock badges, and click-to-order
- Interactive Order Management system (`Table 8` and multi-table support)
- Order summary with live Subtotal, Tax, Promo Discount, Total calculations, and thermal receipt printing
- Dark theme (`#1f2029` / `#17181f`) with Deep Orange (`#ff6e40` / `#ff5722`) accents
